definitions.explanation: A designated path or route for activities such as running, driving, or golf.
A structured program, plan, or set of dishes served in sequence at a restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コース⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
ゴルフコース⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a golf course.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧コース⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧で⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: This walking course has beautiful scenery and feels refreshing.

examples.english: At this restaurant, you can enjoy course meals starting from 3,000 yen.

notes:
コース comes from English "course" and is used in several contexts.

SENSE 1 (route/track):
- ⟦マラソン→マラソン：04732_marason⟧コース: marathon course
- ゴルフコース: golf course
- ⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧コース: walking route
- ⟦ドライブ→ドライブ：03866_doraibu⟧コース: driving route

SENSE 2 (program/set menu):
- コース⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: course meal, set menu
- ⟦{飲|の}み{放題|ほうだい}→飲み放題：08308_nomihoudai⟧コース: all-you-can-drink plan
- ⟦{初心者|しょしんしゃ}→初心者：10149_shoshinsha⟧コース: beginner's course (study program)

USAGE:
At Japanese restaurants, コース⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ refers to a multi-dish set menu served in sequence, as opposed to ordering individual dishes (⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧). It is very common for group dining and parties.
